title: Editorial Narrative Remediation
methodology: Every affected entity's summary (and, for leaf entities, the derived seo_description) was individually rewritten with genuine, entity-specific prose — never mechanical word substitution. Leaf-tier wine-pairing conclusions were grounded in each entity's actual governed relationship data (data/runtime/*-wine-relationships.json pairs_with_style/pairs_with_wine edges), not invented, satisfying both this phase's and AQ-07D's requirement not to fabricate pairing claims. Group/category-tier text was rewritten to remove internal architecture references while preserving and, in several cases, extending the real descriptive content already present (member-ingredient examples, style/technique explanations).

findings_beyond_aq07b_scanner.description: Manual review during remediation (not the automated 14-term scanner) surfaced additional internal-architecture leaks the keyword list did not anticipate — exactly the kind of gap the ticket's own instruction not to rely blindly on automated detection was written for.
examples: Raw snake_case field names in prose: 'plant_part', 'edible_structure', 'fungal_body', found across protein's 17 groups and 3 categories (e.g. 'Legumes, soy foods, grains, nuts and seeds — plant_category with plant_part and edible_structure').
Architecture phrases without a tracked term match: 'intrinsic metadata', 'graph relationships', 'poster-level culinary identity', also concentrated in protein's group/category summaries.

'canonical entities with frozen intrinsic metadata for classification and identity' — cheese's group-tier introduction text, present verbatim across all 9 cheese groups, the single most severe instance of internal-architecture language found in this initiative.
findings_beyond_aq07b_scanner.action: All fixed in the same remediation pass, using the same standard (real, differentiated, consumer-facing prose) applied to the AQ-07B-scanner-identified leaks.

verification.post_remediation_governance_language_sca: 0 rendered consumer-facing hits (reports/editorial-governance-language-07b.json's scanner re-run, see current_status: PASS)
verification.structural_integrity: All 11 catalogs verified: entity counts (leaf/group/category) unchanged before and after remediation across every domain — 1,166 leaf, 73 group, 13 category entities total, matching AQ-07A's baseline exactly.
verification.diff_scope: git diff confirms only summary, seo_description, introduction, and beginner_notes fields were ever modified across all 11 catalog files — no id, no ownership field, no wine_pairings, no relationship, no governance field touched anywhere.
verification.wine_pairing_grounding: Every legume/nut-seed/sweet-flavor/sauce-condiment leaf entity's new wine-pairing conclusion traces to that entity's actual pairs_with_style/pairs_with_wine edge in its domain's runtime relationship file — verified by construction (the extraction script pulled this data before any prose was written), not asserted after the fact.

regression.verification_method: git status/diff against every protected path, confirmed clean before this commit.

overall_status: PASS — 0 forbidden internal governance terminology remaining in any rendered consumer-facing narrative field, across all 1,166 leaf, 73 group, and 13 category entities in all 11 domains.
